confirm.title: Recheck held vacuum
confirm.description:
Adaptive RoboVacs held {robot} after a cleaning request for {room} failed. {reason}

Safe preparation failures retry after 2, 5, 15, then at most 30 minutes. A start that remained docked and never reported cleaning gets one retry after a stable ready dock. Uncertain physical starts still need review. This Repair rechecks fresh state without sending a cleaning command.

confirm.title: Recheck and resume Adaptive RoboVacs
confirm.description:
Adaptive RoboVacs stopped all new scheduler dispatch after a cleaning request failed for {room} with {robot}. {reason}

When the vacuum is docked, submitting this Repair clears the stale halt without sending a cleaning command. Battery, availability, adapter compatibility, occupancy, and Home Assistant area mapping are checked later when a new clean is due. If it is already cleaning and the integration cannot confirm which room it is cleaning, the clean is treated as native-app activity: the halt clears without recording a scheduled room as cleaned and without interrupting the vacuum.

storage_unsafe.title: Adaptive RoboVacs storage needs attention
storage_unsafe.description: Adaptive RoboVacs could not validate its saved scheduler state ({reason}). Dispatch is disabled and the original Store remains untouched. Open this Repair to back up and reset only this integration data, or repair the saved data manually.

confirm.title: Back up and reset scheduler data
confirm.description: This discards this integration’s saved jobs, holds, cleaning history, learned durations, floor plan and settings. The exact unsafe payload is copied to a separate Home Assistant Store and verified before replacement. The new scheduler starts in observe-only mode; enabling dispatch later is a separate action. No clean is started.

room_error_recovery.title: Adaptive RoboVacs room needs recovery confirmation

confirm.title: Allow the unfinished room stage to retry
confirm.description:
The {operation} stage in {room} was interrupted on {robot}. {reason}

Resolve the physical error and return the vacuum to a ready dock. The unfinished stage is released automatically after three uninterrupted minutes of ready docking; it is never marked complete. You can also submit this Repair after the interruption has been safely detached. Normal occupancy, cleaning windows, battery, and water checks still apply.

error.awaiting_safe_dock: Resolve the vacuum error and dock it. Wait for stable dock confirmation, then try again.
error.recovery_changed: This interruption has changed. Close this Repair and open the current one.
error.recovery_target_unavailable: The saved room, vacuum, or cleaning stage cannot be matched. Restore the original room and vacuum configuration, then try again.
error.recovery_unavailable: Recovery is unavailable while the integration is stopping or its saved state needs repair.

robot_error_recovery.title: Adaptive RoboVacs scheduler hold needs review

confirm.title: Recheck and release this scheduler hold
confirm.description:
{reason} {state}

Resolve any physical error, then let {robot} return to a ready dock. This hold clears automatically after three uninterrupted minutes when the saved attempt can be safely identified or abandoned. You can also submit this Repair for a fresh recheck. No cleaning command is sent and normal occupancy, window, battery, Party Mode, and observe-only checks remain in force.

confirm.title: Confirm localization and room mapping
confirm.description: Map snapshots and map-selection controls have been removed. {robot} still has an unconfirmed map selection from an older version. Check that the robot is correctly localized on the intended map and that its Home Assistant room mapping is correct. With the robot docked or idle and no tracked clean active, submit this Repair to recheck the mapping and release only this hold. This sends no physical command and starts no clean.
